description: This is a 3D model of a modern staircase with a unique design. It appears to be an indoor staircase, possibly leading to a mezzanine or upper level. The staircase features a curved or spiral design, with steps that are yellow and green, possibly representing different materials or a decorative element. It is enclosed within a transparent or semi-transparent structure, suggesting a contemporary architectural style. The overall aesthetic is minimalist and clean, with a focus on form and function. The staircase is elevated from a grey base, with a larger grey platform surrounding it.
